title: pleurospermum capillaceum
intro: Pleurospermum capillaceum, commonly known as Mountain Carrot, is a plant species belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Pleurospermum capillaceum include its use as an antispasmodic, antiseptic, and diuretic, making it effective in treating various conditions. Bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
